+import pytest
+
+from mlflow.entities import LoggedModel, LoggedModelStatus
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("status_message", ["Upload failed", "", None])
+def test_status_message_proto_round_trip(status_message):
+    model = LoggedModel(
+        experiment_id="1",
+        model_id="m-123",
+        name="model",
+        artifact_location="/artifacts/model",
+        creation_timestamp=1000,
+        last_updated_timestamp=2000,
+        status=LoggedModelStatus.FAILED,
+        status_message=status_message,
+    )
+
+    proto = model.to_proto()
+    assert proto.info.status_message == (status_message or "")
+    assert proto.info.HasField("status_message") == (status_message is not None)
+
+    restored = LoggedModel.from_proto(proto)
+    assert restored.status_message == (status_message or "")
+    assert restored.status == LoggedModelStatus.FAILED
